groundCover.label: Ground Cover
groundCover.hint: Changes the color and texture of the ground in the game and the colors of 2D maps. It does not affect the simulation.

climate.label: Climate
climate.hint: Sets how the weather behaves in each season (how often it is sunny, rainy, or snowy). It does not affect the simulation.
